The fact that Ramadan is a recurring experience, happening every year, means that individuals have the opportunity to reflect on their values and priorities annually. This can lead to a continuous process of growth, self-reflection, and refinement, as individuals strive to become better versions of themselves. In many ways, the experience of Ramadan can be seen as a catalyst for personal transformation, encouraging individuals to re-examine their values, priorities, and relationships.
